title: Migraine with aura detection and subtype classification using machine learning algorithms and morphometric magnetic resonance imaging data
summary: MRI morphometry plus machine learning distinguished migraine with aura and its subtypes in a disease-specific imaging cohort; the small sample limits generalization. Methods analyze MRI morphometry from 78 subjects with ML; Results distinguish migraine-with-aura groups, with limited sample size.
